description: A tall lattice drilling derrick stands on a flat, muddy field under a dark, stormy sky. A tall column of fire and black smoke rises from a pipe with a valve beside it. Parked trucks and small figures of workers are in the foreground, and a windmill and low farm buildings sit on the horizon beside a canal. The painting is in an oil-painting style, warm firelight against dark tones, with no visible text or frame.
